note: Detailed Cruising Regions (Regions and Harbours 2026): areas of the world with more local harbours, anchorages and coastal destinations (data/cruising/destinations.json). A harbour belongs to a region when its country is the region's and it lies inside one of the region's outlines (lon, lat). 'symbol' and 'label' place the chart's quiet mark; 'chart_regions' name the detail charts (data/navigation/regions.json) that cover it; 'look' is the waterfront's town palette (HarbourDressing.TOWNS). More regions are more entries here.
